Subject: Update on Your Budget Request

Dear [Name],

Thank you for submitting your request for a budget increase. After careful review, we are unable to approve the request at this time, as the current justification does not align with our company's financial strategy.

However, we encourage you to resubmit your proposal. To strengthen your case, please include a more detailed explanation along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits. We look forward to reviewing your revised submission.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

Mount Olympus
